GetTagVal.description_en: Retrieves the tag values for a specified tag key from reported traces
GetTagVal.description_zh: 获取上报的链路数据中指定Tag Key对应的Tag Value

GetTrace.description_en: You can invoke the GetTrace API to obtain trace details
GetTrace.description_zh: 调用GetTrace接口获取调用链路详情

ListIpOrHosts.description_en: Queries IP addresses or hostnames in trace data. You can obtain all IP addresses of an application or in a region
ListIpOrHosts.description_zh: 获取链路数据中的IP地址或者机器名称，可获取整个地域或某个应用下的所有IP地址

ListSpanNames.description_en: Retrieves all span names in a specified region. You can also retrieve all span names of a specific microservice
ListSpanNames.description_zh: 获取指定地域下所有的Span名称，也可获取某个微服务的所有Span名称

OpenXtraceService.description_zh: 开通可观测链路 OpenTelemetry 版

QueryMetric.description_zh: 调用QueryMetric查询相关监控指标

SearchTraces.description_en: Call the SearchTraces operation to query a list of traces. You can filter traces by time, application name, IP address, span name, tag, and other criteria
SearchTraces.description_zh: 调用SearchTraces查询调用链列表，可根据时间、应用名称、IP地址、Span名称、Tag等信息对调用链进行过滤查询
